stem: Which statement describes BOTH the Free-Soil Party and the Republican Party in the mid-1800s?

options.label: A
options.text: They supported actions to stop escaped slaves from entering the North.

options.label: B
options.text: They supported enacting safety regulations to protect factory workers.

options.label: C
options.text: They were against the expansion of slavery into the western territories.

options.label: D
options.text: They were against the establishment of American Indian reservations.
